reviewer: Primary implementer; organization-masked copies are not independent blind review.
criteria: Use program-derived numerical ranges over declared coverage; do not extrapolate selected endpoints.
Prediction-query measured backend endpoints count as queried motion; plans-only reads do not count as prediction.
Not displayed is distinct from not queried or not retained.
Terminal reach, holding position and holding speed are separate; joint success requires all three.
Synchronous wall-clock overruns do not imply skipped simulated updates.
Hypotheses can justify bounded exploration without causal proof; exact source agreement does not validate causal prose.
No evidence for a beneficial geometry change is distinct from geometry having no effect.
Actual candidate measurements must support revised diagnosis and final decision.
Different objective scalar values cannot rank different weight settings.

ranking.rule: Joint acceptance first; otherwise componentwise physical comparison.
ranking.tradeoff: Any physical improvement accompanied by physical worsening is a trade-off, not overall improvement.
ranking.computation: Reported separately; never substitutes for reach or holding acceptance.
ranking.objective: Raw scalar objectives under different weights are not ranked.
